Brand Archetype & Direction

Three parts. One brand.

Answer as the brand, not as yourself. There are no wrong answers — the assessment measures instinct, and the instinct is the point.

Part one The business

What you do, where you compete, who you are for. Plain facts — your report’s competitive section is researched from them.

Part two Twelve questions

Mottos, character, fears, symbols. Answer as the brand, not as yourself. Instinct is the point.

Part three Look and feel

Colour, type, style, and where the brand has to work. Mostly tapping, very little typing.

About twelve minutes altogether. When you finish, the Skyway Media team reviews everything and comes back to you with what it means.
